description: Creates a Stripe Checkout link for a PERSON to pay with a card; hand them the checkoutUrl. Live accounts only, $4.99 to $1,000.00. Nothing is credited until they pay. Then call check_topup with the sessionId until credited is true — the balance is credited once, by whichever of Stripe's webhook, check_topup or the payer's own page sees the payment first.
